puzzles.title: Join, do not run to the edge

wrong.why: Your fort ran to the edge. The edge has no roads, and Red got between your fort and its friend.
Your move went into the corner. The corner has no new roads, and Red got between your fort and its friend.

puzzles.better: Build to the left of your tower, toward the middle. There your fort gets the most roads.
puzzles.hint: Count the roads for each spot. The edge and the corner give few roads.
puzzles.say: Your tower with the flag stands on the edge, and Red comes near. Save that tower: run where it gets the most roads.
puzzles.title: Run to the middle

wrong.why: Your tower went into the corner. The corner gives no new roads, and Red closed the way to the middle.
Your tower went down along the edge, toward the red towers. Red closed the way to the middle.

puzzles.hint: Count the roads of your tower. Which move gives it the most roads?
puzzles.say: Red wants to catch your tower. Save it!
